title: The bird on the corn
logline: September 12, two days late in the box: the corn on Gully's counter, the end stool empty, and the bird on the tray's edge. Twenty-eight years. The page's only joke, and it doesn't make it.

panels.composition: Gully's counter: a paper tray of buttered corn beside the empty end stool, the small rainbow bird standing on the tray's rim, the corkboard above, nobody.
